 How gas prices have changed in Mississippi in the last week
 Published 10:36 am Friday, November 6, 2026
 by
 Stacker 
 jittawit21 // Shutterstock
 How gas prices have changed in Mississippi in the last week
 Stacker compiled statistics on gas prices in Mississippi using data from AAA . Gas prices are as of November 6.
 Mississippi by the numbers 
– Gas current price: $3.71
– Week change: -$0.09 (-2.3%)
– Year change: +$1.11 (+42.5%)
– Historical expensive gas price: $4.53 (6/12/22)
 – Diesel current price: $5.78
– Week change: -$0.08 (-1.3%)
– Year change: +$2.50 (+76.5%)
– Historical expensive diesel price: $6.06 (9/23/26)
